captions.detailed: A pedestal box fan featuring a square outer housing with a built-in wire safety grille protecting a light blue five-blade propeller. The fan unit is mounted on a height-adjustable, cylindrical metal pedestal column that rises from a heavy, circular black base. On the rear face of the motor housing, a small black rotary timer knob is mounted. The pedestal column extends via a prismatic joint, the fan blades spin on a central revolute axle, and the timer knob rotates on its own revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a pedestal box fan with a square frame, wire grille, and a five-blade propeller. The assembly should feature a height-adjustable telescoping stand on a circular base and a rotary timer knob on the rear of the motor housing, incorporating prismatic and revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a thick cylinder and the lower column as a hollow cylinder. Create the upper column as a smaller cylinder nested inside the lower column to form a prismatic joint. Build the square fan housing by hollow-cutting a box, then add the motor cylinder and wire grille using radial arrays of thin cylinders. Model the propeller blades by extruding angled profiles and arraying them around a central hub on a revolute joint. Finally, attach a small cylindrical timer knob on a revolute joint to the back of the motor housing.
